title: Greystones, Delgany, Co. Wicklow
description:
* SHORT TERM WEEKLY RENTALS ONLY*

A beautifully appointed comfortable and spacious home very near Delgany Village. 
270m2 With large private garden, 3 large reception rooms, 3 ensuite bathrooms and 1 family bathroom with large Jacuzzi style bathtub.

Downstairs is comprised of a large and bright L shaped space with kitchen, snug, TV, wood burning stove and dining room. 

A large formal sitting room with modern cassette stove, a large family TV room and a  large home office/cloakroom,  porch, entrance hall and downstairs loo. 

Set on a leafy cul de sac this home is on over half an acre with an exceptionally large south facing private patio with 3 garden seating arrangements, parasols and BBQ. 

Only a 4 minute walk from Delgany Village and a 5 minute drive to Greystones DART station. This property is exceptionally located for access to an abundance of local amenities such as schools, sports clubs, golf courses, seaside, mountains, shopping, entertainment and restaurants.

Only a 50 minute drive to Dublin Airport and 35 minutes to Dublin City.  Greystones and the dart station easily accessible with new Bicycle lanes and regular bus service practically on doorstep! A 3 minute walk. 
N11 access is a 2 minute drive. 

A perfect rental for those looking for a private sanctuary on the east coast.
